schedule_activities_three_point_positive.name: schedule_activities_three_point_positive
schedule_activities_three_point_positive.value: ("durationOptimisticDays" is null or "durationOptimisticDays" >= 1) and ("durationPessimisticDays" is null or "durationPessimisticDays" >= 1)

schedule_activities_three_point_window.name: schedule_activities_three_point_window
schedule_activities_three_point_window.value: "durationOptimisticDays" is null or "durationPessimisticDays" is null or ("durationOptimisticDays" <= "durationDays" and "durationDays" <= "durationPessimisticDays")
